about: Known differences between OpenRig and shared/src/openrig that are NOT drift. `unmapped`: OpenRig has it, we deliberately don't model it. `oursOnly`: we model it, OpenRig's normaliser doesn't read it. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check.

unmapped.reason: chain-file-convention.md 'The project tree': a legacy alternative name the walkers read when NOTES.md is absent. We model NOTES.md only; nothing in AppyRig reads mission notes yet.

oursOnly.reason: agent-spec.md documents top-level `description` (shown in the spec library and review surfaces) and 19 shipped agent.yaml files use it; normalizeAgentSpec reads `summary` instead.
agent-spec.md: 'Spec review surfaces read a profile `description`'; normalizeProfile reads `summary`.
